briefings.headline: See Baz’s fastball; stay disciplined on the curve
briefings.message: Shane Baz is the high-confidence predicted starter (85% prediction probability). Left-handed hitters, be ready for his fastball and don’t chase the curve. Juan Soto has the strongest projected matchup; Carson Benge and the other lefties should look for fastballs. Right-handed hitters, be ready for the fastball-heavy mix and stay alert for the breaking ball. If a left-handed reliever enters late, Mark Vientos is the planned pinch-hit option for Jared Young.
reminders: Soto: hunt fastballs; respect the curve.
Benge: look fastball and stay disciplined on breaking balls.
Righties: be ready for fastballs; don’t give away the breaking ball.

briefings.headline: Manaea sets the tone; keep the ball out of the middle
briefings.message: Sean Manaea starts, with a five-inning target and a 90-pitch limit. Keep the ball away from the middle against Pete Alonso and finish with breaking stuff below the zone. Use the left-handed matchup and breaking balls against Gunnar Henderson, Dylan Beavers, and Samuel Basallo; handle Coby Mayo and Christian Encarnacion-Strand carefully, as they have projected edges against Manaea. Use available bullpen arms first and save limited relievers for urgent spots.
reminders: Nate Lavender: left-handed pockets or a high-leverage bridge; Daniel Duarte: highest-leverage late spot.
Use rested middle and long relief before limited arms when possible.
Kodai Senga, Dedniel Núñez, and Jonathan Pintaro are limited after pitching yesterday; Jonah Tong is unavailable.

briefings.headline: Execute the approved plan and manage rest carefully
briefings.message: Keep the approved lineup and start Sean Manaea with a five-inning target and a 90-pitch limit. Juan Soto stays for the clearest projected matchup; Francisco Lindor rests on an even matchup, while Carson Benge and Bo Bichette start despite rest suggestions. Protect Manaea from the projected batter edges for Coby Mayo and Christian Encarnacion-Strand. Preserve rested bullpen arms and use limited relievers only when needed. Jonah Tong is unavailable.
reminders: Soto, Benge, and Bichette have rest suggestions; all remain in the lineup as approved.
Lindor is resting; use the planned substitution options if game situations call for them.
Kodai Senga, Dedniel Núñez, and Jonathan Pintaro are limited after pitching yesterday.
